description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Soul Break Gauge +150] to party, grants [Master Mode], [Instant ATB 1] & [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 4, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Holy/NE physical attacks, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Holy/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, removes Master Mode

description.name: Master Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed and no cost for the first Soul Break cast, grants [Hero Boost] and sets the Hero Boost level to 1 when set

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999
